discovery.title: Women’s sports are drawing bigger audiences—but the old barriers still matter
discovery.summary: A new Associated Press report looks at the changing place of women’s sports in the United States, from rising television audiences and major wins to persistent expectations about female athletes’ bodies.
discovery.why_it_matters: Sport can reflect changing ideas about who gets to compete and be celebrated, while shaping opportunities for the next generation of athletes.
